clearedSpotChecks.check: The three scripts of cycles/028/hyperevm.work/scripts/borrow.py that make each unchecked subtraction of getFeeGrowthInside borrow (src/libraries/Pool.sol:497-510) and feed the wrapped difference into the fee multiplication of src/libraries/Position.sol:91-96, run by eth_call with state overrides on ten Ethereum endpoints.
clearedSpotChecks.note: The cited lines are the unchecked subtractions of src/libraries/Pool.sol:497-510 and the unchecked mulDiv of src/libraries/Position.sol:91-96, as stated. out/borrow-eth.json lists one reference hash per script and equal true for every endpoint that answered, each bracketed by the same client version before and after, with the 403 and the Flashbots refusal recorded as errors. As an independent edge read, an eth_call I ran of MULMOD(2^255, 2^255, 2^256 - 1), the modulus form of src/libraries/FullMath.sol:24, returned 0x40 followed by 62 zeros (2^254, the correct value) on Geth/v1.17.10 linux-arm64 at rpc.mevblocker.io and on reth/v2.11.0-b9abbcc at ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Arithmetic and jump code in the evm2 revision that reth main pins (e80df9c4), with DIV and MOD now using checked_div and checked_rem with unwrap_or_default.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched reth main Cargo.toml: lines 451-454 pin evm2 rev e80df9c46a8240b056a076ab930b1c5ecf7f1e47 and lines 697-700 patch it to DaniPopes/evm2 at the same rev. I fetched arithmetic.rs at that rev: div writes a.checked_div(b).unwrap_or_default() and rem writes a.checked_rem(b).unwrap_or_default(), which give 0 for a zero divisor as the EVM specifies, and sdiv, smod, addmod, mulmod are delegated as stated. So UnsafeMath.divRoundingUp (src/libraries/UnsafeMath.sol:12-15) and div(not(0), price) at src/libraries/TickMath.sol:104 compute the specified result on that revision. No endpoint runs this revision yet, which the unit's own low lead records.
